description: Keys the engine must maintain on PlayerState for gates to work.
note: A flag written as '!name' in a gate means 'not set'. Supported by runtime/canon.ts.

sources.day: tower arrivals (core event arenaEntered on a tower segment)
sources.roosts.dark: sunsets so far: floor(day / visits_between_sunsets), applied in sunset_order
sources.talks.ferryman: TALK presses on boss.ferryman (core event talk)
sources.logs.player: LOG presses at a tower terminal
sources.reads.item.journal.steward: READ presses on the journal tile
sources.carried.npc.keeper.0N: CARRY on that keeper, then arriving at the next tower with them
sources.reached.final_roost: arrival at the last tower the schedule leaves lit

engine: src/shell/story.js owns PlayerState and writes these from core events; the core never sees canon text
